# QuietKey M15 deterministic signature-insertion fixture, permanently NEVER-FUND.
# Generated outside Git after ratification using high-entropy ephemeral account private keys and chain codes from the OS CSPRNG.
# Every ECDSA signature used a distinct high-entropy OS-CSPRNG nonce; strict low-S DER plus trailing SIGHASH_ALL is committed.
# A separately written Perl Math::BigInt/Digest::SHA verifier reparsed every descriptor, PSBT, digest, signature, stage, projected review, and final byte string and agreed byte-for-byte.
# The generator, every private scalar, every nonce, and all intermediates were destroyed after the two implementations agreed.
# All account and derived public keys were screened against every committed compressed public-key token, QK-DEC-059 NUMS authority/child set, and M8/BIP32/BIP143/Wycheproof KAT set with no collision.
# The descriptor pair below is a second fixture-only lineage with its own wallet_id; it and every PSBT are permanently NEVER-FUND.
# Each case embeds complete initial bytes and every response; successful cases additionally embed every per-insertion canonical PSBT, its ordinary current-S0 M14 review, and the approved-S0 frozen comparison transcript.
# Processing tuple: ascending input index, then ascending partial-signature pubkey bytes; arrival order is intentionally irrelevant.
# Approved ReviewHash is pre-insertion only and is never recomputed or replaced.
# No seed, xprv, private scalar, nonce, signing code, generator, address, funded object, or production wallet material is committed.
# response_N is input|authenticated-descriptor-role|DER-only; response_N_expected_pubkey is an oracle, never caller input, and the wrapper appends 01.
# stage_N_actual_review is the ordinary current-S0 M14 transcript. stage_N_frozen_review is a NON-M14 comparison projection retaining the approved S0 identity; it is never hashed or approved.
# Closed inventory: 22 cases = 4 complete emissions + 15 named rejections + 3 binding rejections.
